rationale: Independently verified exact proposal/candidate/authored-v9 and both semantic-review bindings, all 133 current runtime-source hashes, nine source bindings and the prescribed current derived/quick reviewed pins. All 68 supporting candidate cores and 49 candidate item payloads remain exact V1.9 inheritances; their actual current pack records, archived core hashes and label/category concept scopes match. The proposal contains exactly 49 accepted additions across 27 boards with no diagnostics; every candidate/entry/core hash and pair/result/two-edge identity verifies. All 263 unique node snapshots and 334 unique edge snapshots equal the current authoritative KG, including provenance/default fields. Each proposed core recipe list, route list, seeds, target and par matches its supporting archived core. Inspection of the saved native auditor confirms it rebuilds those projections and uses a bounded six-action MinimumPlan to verify optimal par after adding recipes; the saved audit reports all 27 boards and 49 additions passing with preserved graph provenance and core routes/par. Its replay-named counters are structural, projection and finite-planner evidence, not HTTP requests or game-session action replays. No audit was rerun and no new recipe facts or held graph items are admitted.
